mathematics.assertion_tested: Four Lean real-algebra lemmas: exact coupling polynomial, negative quadratic coefficient, negative linear coefficient, and negative quarter-discriminant for every nonnegative coupling parameter under explicit hypotheses.
mathematics.coefficient_domain: Real numbers with exact rational constants
mathematics.conventions: q=Q^2, x=X=Q^2-Y, z=parallel gradient squared, t=2 gamma^2 X/M^2. The proxy marginal reduction, action variation, and Einstein elimination are separately derived, not Lean-formalized tensor calculus.

bounds.domain: p,r,z,x,W,F>0; x<=q-z; C,w,t>=0; physical use requires affine background Hessian and nonzero clock Schur denominator

non_claims: No theorem for arbitrary nonzero background Hessians
No existence of an on-shell finite-gradient background
No nonlinear Dirac count, complete field theory, empirical law, or novelty priority certificate
